facts.fact: 帕苏阿号切入萨多维亚频率，塔拉辛向维拉发出呼叫。
facts.anchor: the Parsua tapped into the Sardovian frequency

facts.fact: 塔拉辛一开口就向维拉提出谈判停火。
facts.anchor: “I want to negotiate a ceasefire,” Talasyn told Vela.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛指出凯萨斯现在只剩昔日一半的战力。
facts.anchor: Kesath is operating at half of its former capacity

facts.fact: 维拉承认塔拉辛根本没给她留多少选择的余地。
facts.anchor: You haven’t afforded me much of a choice here, Harlikaan.

facts.fact: 维拉说塔拉辛的外祖母会为她骄傲。
阿伦西娜·伊弗拉利斯独自乘蛾形小艇穿过凯萨斯阵线赴召，令部下大为惊骇。
facts.anchor: Much to the horror of her troops, Alunsina Ivralis answered the Night Emperor’s summons alone, disappearing behind Kesathese lines on a moth coracle.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克当面点明这间屋子里只有一个人还戴着婚戒。
facts.anchor: there’s only one person wearing a wedding band in this room

facts.fact: 塞夫雷姆通报摄政盖赫里斯发来传召，要阿拉里克把扎希亚-拉奇斯带去见他。
facts.anchor: “Regent Gaheris has sent a message, Your Majesty,” he informed Alaric, quiet and tense.
